en.name: Sauce mix, non-dairy
en.summary: These are the dry, dairy-free sachets — spaghetti sauce mix, taco seasoning and the like — made of dried herbs, spices, starch and salt. Unopened they keep about 2 years from purchase in the cupboard. The made-up sauce is a different thing entirely and is a perishable leftover.
en.pantry: An unopened packet keeps about 2 years from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. With no dairy and no fat to go rancid, these mixes are among the most stable things on a shelf; what ends them is damp and insects. Keep packets away from the hob and the kettle, and once one is opened, tip the remainder into a small airtight jar rather than folding the paper over. Label the jar with the date and cut the mixing instructions from the packet to tape on.
en.fridge: The dry mix should not go in the fridge — taking a packet in and out drives condensation into the powder and cakes it. Once you have made the sauce up with water, tomatoes or stock, it is a cooked dish and belongs in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, cooled quickly in a shallow container and treated as a leftover on its own short timeline, not on the packet's.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for a dry sauce mix and freezing a powder gains nothing while risking condensation. The made-up sauce, on the other hand, usually freezes well — a tomato-based spaghetti sauce or a taco filling portioned flat in bags at −18 °C (0 °F) is a genuinely useful thing to have. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; the limit is flavour.
en.thawing: Thaw made-up sauce in the fridge or reheat it straight from frozen in a covered pan, stirring. Bring it to a full boil before serving and never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A caked, solid block in the packet that will not break up
Insects, larvae or webbing in the packet
A stale, musty or flat smell with no spice aroma left
Made-up sauce that smells sour or has a film on the surface
tips: Decant opened packets into an airtight jar with the date and instructions.
Store away from steam and heat; damp is what ends a dry mix.
Rotate stock so the oldest packet is used first.
Freeze the made-up sauce, not the powder.

faq.q: How long does a dry sauce mix last?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase, unopened in a cool dry cupboard.

faq.q: Should sauce mix be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: No. Moving a packet in and out of the fridge drives condensation into the powder and cakes it. Keep it airtight in a cupboard.

faq.q: Can you freeze made-up sauce from a mix?
faq.a: Usually yes — a tomato-based sauce or taco filling freezes well in flat bags at −18 °C. The dry powder gains nothing from freezing.

faq.q: Is a sauce mix still usable after the date?
faq.a: It is a quality question rather than a safety one for a dry, low-fat mix. If it smells of nothing and has caked, it will not make a good sauce.

zh.name: 乾式醬料粉包（不含乳製品）
zh.summary: 這裡指的是不含乳製品的乾燥粉包——義大利麵醬粉、塔可調味粉之類，成分是乾燥香草、香料、澱粉和鹽。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。調好的醬則完全是另一回事，屬於易腐的剩菜。
zh.pantry: 未開封的粉包放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。因為沒有乳製品、也沒有會走油耗的油脂，這類粉包是架上最穩定的東西之一；終結它的是潮濕和蟲害。請遠離爐火和熱水壺；開封後把剩下的倒進小密封罐，不要只把袋口折起來。罐上標好日期，並把包裝上的沖調說明剪下來貼上。
zh.fridge: 乾粉不該放冰箱——粉包反覆進出會讓冷凝水進入粉裡並結塊。一旦你用水、番茄或高湯把它調煮成醬，它就是一道熟食，該用淺容器快速降溫後放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並依剩菜自己的短時限處理，而不是依粉包的期限。
zh.freezer: 乾式醬料粉包沒有冷凍期限，冷凍粉末沒有好處，還可能帶來冷凝水。相對地，調煮好的醬通常很適合冷凍——番茄基底的義大利麵醬或塔可內餡，平放裝袋放 −18 °C，是很實用的常備品。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，限制的是風味。
zh.thawing: 調好的醬請放冷藏解凍，或直接蓋鍋從冷凍加熱並持續攪拌。上桌前要煮到大滾，也絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 包裝裡結成敲不散的硬塊
包裝內有蟲、幼蟲或蟲絲
聞起來陳悶、扁平，完全沒有香料氣味
調好的醬發酸，或表面結了一層膜
tips: 開封後倒進密封罐，並標上日期和沖調說明。
遠離蒸氣和熱源；毀掉乾粉的是潮濕。
要冷凍就冷凍調好的醬，不要冷凍粉。

faq.q: 乾式醬料粉包可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。
不要。粉包反覆進出冰箱會讓冷凝水進入粉裡並結塊。請密封放櫥櫃。

faq.q: 用粉包調好的醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 通常可以——番茄基底的醬或塔可內餡平放裝袋放 −18 °C 效果很好。乾粉冷凍則沒有好處。

faq.q: 過了日期的醬料粉還能用嗎？
faq.a: 對乾燥低脂的粉包來說，這比較是品質而不是安全問題。如果完全聞不到香氣又結塊，就調不出好醬。
